title.zh: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
title.en: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】

current_state.zh: b14g 漏洞导致约 9700 万枚质押 CORE 被未经授权提取；b14g 已暂停受影响合约。Core DAO 表示 Core 网络安全未受影响，并正与 b14g 及交易所合作追踪和冻结资金，大部分被盗 CORE 仍在 Core 链上。
current_state.en: The b14g vulnerability led to the unauthorized extraction of about 97 million staked CORE; b14g paused affected contracts. Core DAO says Core network security is unaffected and is coordinating with b14g and exchanges to trace and freeze funds, with most stolen CORE still on the Core chain.

updates.title_zh: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
updates.title_en: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
updates.what_changed_zh: 比特币双重质押层b14g报告称，约9700万枚质押的CORE代币被未经授权提取，促使其暂停受影响合约，并与Core、安全合作伙伴及交易所合作冻结和追回资金，目前约900万枚CORE已被冻结，另有6800万枚仍在Core链上。
updates.what_changed_en: b14g, a Bitcoin dual-staking layer, reported that about 97 million staked CORE tokens were extracted without authorization, prompting it to pause the affected contracts and work with Core, security partners and exchanges to freeze and recover funds, with roughly 9 million CORE frozen and 68 million still on the Core chain.

updates.title_zh: 【Core DAO：b14g 漏洞不影响 Core 网络安全】
updates.title_en: 【Core DAO：b14g 漏洞不影响 Core 网络安全】
updates.what_changed_zh: Core DAO 就 b14g 漏洞事件作出回应，称该漏洞不影响 Core 网络安全，Core 共识、验证者及质押合约全程正常运行，直接或通过其他协议质押的 CORE 不受影响；其正与 b14g 及交易所合作追踪并冻结攻击者资金，大部分被盗 CORE 仍留在 Core 链上。
updates.what_changed_en: Core DAO responded to the b14g vulnerability, saying it does not affect Core network security; Core consensus, validators and staking contracts operated normally, and CORE staked directly or through other protocols was unaffected. It is coordinating with b14g and exchanges to trace and freeze attacker funds, with most stolen CORE still on the Core chain.

updates.current_state_en: The b14g vulnerability led to the unauthorized extraction of about 97 million staked CORE; b14g paused affected contracts. Core DAO says Core network security is unaffected and is coordinating with b14g and exchanges to trace and freeze funds, with most stolen CORE still on the Core chain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Core DAO said the b14g vulnerability that led to the unauthorized withdrawal of roughly 97 million staked CORE does not affect Core network security, and it is coordinating with b14g and exchanges to trace and freeze attacker funds.
